Instructions for Use
Device description: The Aster Spinal System is a spinal fixation system. It is available in lengths from 12 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MR Safety
The Aster Spinal System is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 and 3.0 Tesla when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- head transmit/receive coil only.
- Receive with the head transmit/receive coil.
- Use CP mode only (circularly polarized RF excitation).
1.5 T scanning conditions:
- B1+rms must not exceed 3.2 uT; when B1+rms is not displayed, use a whole body SAR of 2 W/kg or less.
3 T scanning conditions:
- WB-SAR ≤ 0.1 W/kg.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
